The same runtime, the same 25 millisecond resumes, wherever your workloads need to live.

  • Managed cloud

    The fastest path to production. Fully managed by Blaxel, with tier-based quotas that scale as you grow. Reach 100,000+ concurrent sandboxes.

    Run on Blaxel's managed cloud offering but interconnect your virtual private cloud through private endpoints, so your data never transits the public internet.

[FAQ]

Frequently Asked Questions

How fast does an agent resume after being idle?
Sandboxes scale to zero after about 5 seconds of inactivity and resume from standby in roughly 25ms, even after months of being suspended.
Does my agent keep its memory between runs?
Yes. In-memory filesystem snapshots keep a suspended sandbox ready to resume with all running processes persisted. For guaranteed long-term persistence, attach a Volume or use Agent Drive, which can retain data for years.
How isolated is each agent?
Every agent runs in its own hardware-isolated microVM with full access to its filesystem, processes, and logs, plus native support for Zero Data Retention.
How long can an agent run?
Sandboxes are built for workloads lasting anywhere from a few seconds to multiple days.
What does it cost to keep an agent on standby?
You stop paying for compute while a sandbox is suspended. You only pay the standby snapshot storage rate to keep it ready for instant resume.
